issues.body: Carried over unchanged from round 1 and still only a nit. The `odrl:use` half of `sparql_query_requires_concrete_read_action` restates `unmapped_action_materializes_nothing` (test 6, same policy shape, same request), and the `odrl:read` half restates `round_trip_through_enforcement` (test 3, same `sel`, same `rows.len() == 1`). The genuinely new coverage is the two `query_as` assertions that bracket the contract: 0 rows for the unmapped `use` request and 1 row for the concrete `read` request. The round-2 additions (reason string, `mode.is_none()`, `grant_triple.is_none()`) materially raised this test's signal, so the remaining duplication is maintenance surface only, not a correctness or vacuity problem. Not blocking.
issues.fix_hint: Optional, and reasonable to decline: keeping this as the named, greppable home of the sq-lrtc3.2 contract is defensible. If trimming is preferred, drop the `read_store` half (covered verbatim by test 3) and fold the `use`-side `query_as(...).rows.len() == 0` assertion into test 6 with a doc comment cross-referencing sq-lrtc3.2. Do not resolve it by deleting either `query_as` assertion — those two lines are the only new coverage.

verdict.summary:
Round 2 of the doc-and-test-only PR recording the sq-lrtc3.2 decision (a SPARQL query is expressed with the standard odrl:read action; sparq mints no profile-specific query action IRI; an odrl:use request stays unmapped). Both substantive round-1 findings are fixed.

(1) The round-1 MAJOR is resolved: skills/usage-control-policy/SKILL.md:303 now reads `Request::new("http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/read")` instead of the nonexistent `ODRL_READ` symbol. This matches the SKILL's own runnable example at SKILL.md:285 and the local `odrl("read")` helper used by the test. A repo-wide grep confirms `ODRL_READ` still exists only as private consts in gui/src-tauri/src/odrl.rs:242 and crates/sparq-lws-core/src/authz/odrl.rs:44, neither of which the SKILL now references.

(2) The round-1 MINOR is resolved: the new test now asserts the discriminating reason string `"no WAC/ACP mode mapping"`, plus `mode.is_none()` and `grant_triple.is_none()`. That string is produced only by the unmapped-action arm at crates/sparq-solid/src/odrl_bridge.rs:363-366; the deny/ambiguous arm at odrl_bridge.rs:356-358 returns `decision.unmet_constraints` and cannot contain it. Since the test is green, it empirically takes the unmapped-action path, so the documented claim ("permitted request, but the action is unmapped") is now genuinely pinned rather than conflated with a plain deny.

Verified locally: `cargo test -p sparq-solid --features odrl-bridge --test odrl_bridge` -> 74 passed / 0 failed, including `sparql_query_requires_concrete_read_action`. `cargo doc -p sparq-solid --features odrl-bridge --no-deps` is warning-free, so the new module doc's `[Mode::Read]` intra-doc links resolve (the feature-gated doc-link trap is clear). `scripts/check-readme-template.py` reports 0 deviations across 62 READMEs; the README reflow preserves the Conditions/Deny-retraction prose verbatim and MD013 is disabled in .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc, so the long lines are house style.
